parents.unchanged: H1-H3 and the reports of the parent analysis, A1-A4 are not changed, re-tested or re-interpreted

development_data: The gated rule and its statistic were developed after examining the SHHS1 holdout, the telemetry cohort and Sleep-EDF out-of-fold predictions (exploratory, 11 November 2026). These cohorts are development data for A5 and are not evidence for it. ISRUC subgroup I is the only evaluation cohort; it was never downloaded or examined before this lock.

cohort.name: ISRUC-Sleep subgroup I
cohort.subjects: all 100 subjects; a subject is excluded only if a required channel is missing, its unit is not microvolts or its label file cannot be aligned by the rule below; exclusions are fixed and reported before any label is compared with a prediction
cohort.files: raw recording N/N.rec (EDF), scorer label files N/N_1.txt and N/N_2.txt; the provider-filtered ExtractedChannels files are not used
cohort.resampling: 200 Hz to 100 Hz on the continuous signal before epoching: scipy.signal.resample_poly up 1, down 2, window ('kaiser', 5.0); a recording at another rate is resampled by the reduced integer ratio with the same window

labels.alignment: one label per 30 s epoch from the recording start; if the label file is longer than the signal, trailing labels are dropped; if it is shorter, the remaining signal is marked unknown (-1); the number of epochs adjusted is reported per subject

cohort.preprocessing: the trailing incomplete 30 s epoch is dropped; evaluation window and variants exactly as Sleep-EDF and SHHS1 (sleeptcn.preprocessing.trim_sleep_window and preprocess_signal_variant, default PreprocessConfig)

inference: archived fold checkpoints (runs/holdout_ckpt_restore_20261010), mean of the ten fold softmax outputs in float64, argmax, no weight updates; any device; before ISRUC inference the device must reproduce stored telemetry ensemble probabilities of E0_s42 and E4_s42 for two recordings within 1e-4 with identical argmax

rule.statistic: amplitude disagreement of a recording: among epochs whose band-pass epoch standard deviation is at or above the Sleep-EDF threshold (16.513058 uV, configs/amendment_a3.json rule, fitted on all 153 Sleep-EDF recordings) and that the ensemble predicts as N2 or N3, the share predicted N2; undefined (rule not applied) when fewer than 20 such epochs exist
rule.gate: per arm, the 95th percentile of the statistic over the 153 Sleep-EDF recordings scored with that arm's out-of-fold predictions (runs/a3/sleep_edf_oof); computed from source data only
rule.correction: in a recording whose statistic exceeds the gate, every epoch predicted N2 whose band-pass standard deviation is at or above the threshold is relabelled N3 (A3 rule R1); other recordings are unchanged

comparators.ungated_R1: A3 rule R1 applied to every recording
comparators.entropy_gate: same correction, gated instead by the recording's mean prediction entropy above the 95th percentile of the Sleep-EDF out-of-fold recordings of the same arm

rule.no_tuning: no threshold, percentile or minimum count is chosen on ISRUC

analysis.detector: within ISRUC, Spearman correlation of the amplitude statistic and of the mean entropy with the recording's N3 recall (recordings with at least 20 reference N3 epochs), per channel and arm
analysis.channel_contrast: per arm, F4 minus C4 in N3 recall, N3-to-N2 rate and subject-mean macro-F1, paired by subject; the N3/N2 ratio of band-pass epoch standard deviation per channel
analysis.scorer: all results with scorer 1; the primary arm's results repeated with scorer 2

interpretation_rules.rule_supported: On ISRUC C4 with the primary arm, gated rule minus unmodified has a subject-mean macro-F1 interval above zero, and the lower interval bounds of the same difference on ISRUC F4 and on Sleep-EDF out-of-fold are above -0.01.
interpretation_rules.rule_not_supported: On ISRUC C4 with the primary arm, the interval of gated rule minus unmodified includes or lies below zero while the unmodified N3 recall is below 0.5.
interpretation_rules.rule_not_tested: If the primary arm's unmodified N3 recall on ISRUC C4 is 0.7 or higher, ISRUC shows no N3 under-detection and the rule is reported as not tested by this cohort.
interpretation_rules.gate_vs_entropy: Reported as the difference between the amplitude-gated and entropy-gated results with its interval; no claim of superiority unless that interval lies above zero.
interpretation_rules.derivation_account: The N3 deficit is described as derivation-related within ISRUC if F4 minus C4 in N3 recall has an interval above zero for E3 and E4 at both seeds.
interpretation_rules.transfer: A transfer contrast is said to replicate on ISRUC if its seed-42 interval lies above zero; seed 123 is reported beside it.
interpretation_rules.reporting: All arms, channels, comparators and both scorers are reported whatever the outcome; no hypothesis tests.
